name: k8s ARC — a per-repository scale-set listener has no ready container for 5 min
description: Fires, per pod, when MAX(k8s.container.ready) over the trailing 5 min is below 1 for a pod in arc-systems whose name ends in -listener. A per-repository listener is a Pod ARC creates for each AutoscalingListener, not a Deployment, so k8s.deployment.available cannot see it; container readiness is its available-replica equivalent. A listener with no row at all is the lifecycle sweep's stale-listener class. Emitter: k8s_cluster on the poweredge-xubuntu collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml, item livespec-dev-tooling-ec2rkp). Receiver: the poweredge-xubuntu otel-collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml) -> Honeycomb env livespec. Runbook: open the 'Kubernetes workloads and control plane' board; kubectl -n arc-systems get pods; kubectl -n arc-systems logs <listener pod>; kubectl get autoscalinglisteners -A. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-t6om4l.
